policy: Aspirational or non-implemented statements are preserved as vision memory, never shipped as implemented features.

records.interpretation: Granularity Doctrine: one responsibility per module; count systems/features, not files.
Perceptual Superiority Doctrine: highest perceived fidelity per millisecond and per watt on the same device.
Unbounded Architecture Rule: no artificial ceilings in registries, catalogs, LOD chains or generators.
Historical ambition and packaging experiments; not engine features.
Concrete program: PBR discipline, probe GI, temporal reconstruction, geometry virtualization, micro-detail, motion quality, spatial audio, imperfection cues.

records.topic: AAA games in days with AI
records.interpretation: Time-to-World Objective measured in hours from prompt to playable optimized world.
Device tiers exist with real budgets; full runtime parity scheduled.

Roblox offers no editable code surface to a plugin. ARKHER implements the full model side (tokenizer, symbols, diagnostics, completion, rename, metrics) in arkher/runtime/kits_studio (source kit) and arkher/code/intelligence; the pixel-level editor surface is adapter work.

The session/OT layer (presence, locks, op log, rebase) is real and transport agnostic. Roblox networking is authoritative-server only, so true P2P transport is an adapter capability, not an engine claim.
Round 2 ships a complete three-way merge over structured project trees. Binary asset (mesh/texture) diffing needs a content-addressed asset pipeline, which lands with category V.
The taskgraph kit is incremental and content-hashed, which is the hard part. Distributing those tasks across machines is a platform capability, not an engine feature.

records.topic: ARKHER Studio is not a Roblox Studio plugin
records.interpretation: Standing architectural rule restated for Round 2: ARKHER Studio is ARKHER's own IDE (document/commands/selection/layout/widget/inspector/viewport). Releases/ARKHER_V1_STUDIO_PLUGIN.rbxmx is only a display adapter that lets that IDE drive a Roblox Studio session.

records.topic: GPU voxel meshing / compute-shader surface extraction
records.interpretation: Roblox exposes no compute API, so marching-cubes-class meshing cannot run on the GPU. ARKHER ships the complete CPU surface extractor (voxel kit: 6-neighbour face extraction, flood fill, histograms) and a mesh budget governed by D-O15; the GPU path is recorded as a platform capability.

ARKHER terrain is tiled and unbounded by construction (tiles are created on demand and streamed), but a shipped Roblox place is bounded by device memory. The planetary streaming ledger and its paging policy are documented as intent; what ships is unbounded tiling under a measured memory budget.

records.topic: Round-tripping into Roblox native smooth-terrain voxels
records.interpretation: The Terrain Framework owns heightfields, materials, erosion, rivers and LOD meshes as engine data. Writing that data into Roblox's own Terrain voxel store (and reading it back) is adapter work, kept strictly below the abstraction line.

records.topic: Persistent cross-server world state (Modo Vida Real at platform scale)
records.interpretation: The simulation kit already keeps the world alive when unobserved through full/reduced/statistical tiers, and the state is serialisable. Persisting and reconciling that state across many Roblox servers requires the networking family and the Reality Layer original technology.

Round 3 procedural generation is deterministic and grammar-based (WFC, L-systems, rule synthesiser, Poisson scatter, A* networks) precisely so that results are reproducible and debuggable. A learned component that imitates a reference style is a Singularity AI capability, not a procedural one.
